summary: Read-only check of the Connect page scrollbar and of the Field Notes card text fix. Nothing in the app source or data was changed. Page data was replayed in the browser from the saved production fixture (page_connect.json, which has a saved contact-card size: width 1279px, height 825px, moved 2px right and 94px down) and from the preview fixture. All non-GET requests were blocked and no production services were called. CAUSE OF THE SCROLLBAR: index.css fixes the card height at the saved 825px from 961px up, and boxed-layout.css line 374 sets overflow:auto !important on a card with a saved height. The card content is taller than 825px (871px at 1024, 907px at 1280, 941px at 1920), so the card scrolls inside itself. At 1280, before scrolling inside the card, the Send message button is cut off at the card's bottom edge and cannot be clicked (elementFromPoint misses it). The card is also moved 94px down, so it overlaps the footer by 22-43px. Preview data has no saved card size, which is why preview shows no scrollbar. Phone (390) is already fine: no inner scroll. No parent element has a fixed height (none found), so only the card rule needs to change. CANDIDATE (added in the browser only): height auto, min-height var(--ed-h), overflow visible, margin-bottom max(0px, var(--ed-y)). At 1024, 1280 and 1920 the inner scroll is gone (clientHeight equals scrollHeight), the whole form is visible and the button can be clicked, and the page scrolls normally. Width (1158/1279/920px), the two-column grid (476/476 at 1280) and the 2px/94px move are kept. The card ends 51-72px above the footer instead of overlapping it, the same gap as the preview layout without a saved size (64px). One problem: unscoped as written, the candidate adds a 94px gap at 390, because the move offset is turned off on phones but the bottom margin still applies. The scoped version below gives the same page height at 390 as now (1772). FIELD NOTES: max-width:100% on .hfn-card-text and .hfn-card-title that have a saved width (--ed-w) brings the overlap from 3882px² to 0 at 1024 and from 2421px² to 0 at 1080. Column widths do not change and nothing stacks. The output at 1280 is identical.

ui_bugs.component: Connect white contact card (saved height) at 961px and wider
ui_bugs.issue: The card scrolls inside itself (scrollHeight 871-941px vs clientHeight 825px, overflow-y auto). The Send message button is cut off and cannot be clicked until you scroll inside the card. The card also overlaps the footer by 22-43px because of the 94px downward move.

design_issues.screen: Home Field Notes cards at 1024-1080 (known from iteration 31)
issues: The saved text width of 370px is wider than the card column (298-323px), so text runs into the next card. Fixed by max-width:100%; only the text wraps (card 0 text height 41 -> 62px at 1024).

action_items: Contact card: in responsive.css @layer responsive, add (the important declarations in this layer beat the unlayered boxed-layout.css !important overflow:auto, which the test confirmed): body:not(.live-editing) #public-site .pcc-card[style*="--ed-h"] { height:auto !important; overflow:visible !important; } and @media (min-width:961px) and (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { body:not(.live-editing) #public-site .pcc-card[style*="--ed-h"] { min-height:var(--ed-h) !important; margin-bottom:max(0px,var(--ed-y,0px)) !important; } }. Keep min-height and margin-bottom in the desktop-only block: unscoped, they add a 94px empty gap on phones.

Optionally remove or limit the boxed-layout.css line 374 overflow:auto rule to body.live-editing. It is no longer needed on the public page once the rule above is in place. No parent element needs a change.
Field Notes: add to @layer responsive: body:not(.live-editing) #public-site .hfn .hfn-card :is(.hfn-card-text,.hfn-card-title)[style*="--ed-w"] { max-width:100% !important; }

Editor: both rules are limited to body:not(.live-editing), so the editor still shows the exact saved size (it will still show an inner scrollbar while editing if the saved height is too small). Optional: change the White contact card height control text to say it is a minimum height on the public site. A label change is not required.
critical_code_review_comments: layoutStyle (Blocks.jsx line 38) deliberately leaves overflow unset for _contact_card, and boxed-layout.css line 374 adds overflow:auto. Together they turn a saved editor height into a fixed-size scroll box on the public site. Forms grow (validation errors, wider fonts), so a fixed height for the contact card is fragile.
--ed-y is set only when the card has a saved move offset. var(--ed-y,0px) in the candidate handles a missing offset correctly.

success_rate.frontend: Issue reproduced; scoped candidate passes at 1024/1280/1920/390; Field Notes candidate passes at 1024/1080/1280

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use iter32_contact_scroll.py run(page): GET fixture replay via handler_for('prod'|'preview'), with candidate CSS injected through add_style_tag (a style tag in the head is not reset by React re-renders). After the fix, run the 'base' variants only and expect nestedScroll false, cardOverFooter < 0, docH at 390 = 1772 on the prod fixture, and hfnTextOverlapPx2 0 at 1024/1080. Headless Chromium hides scrollbars, so check clientHeight vs scrollHeight rather than relying on screenshots.
rca of the issue: Saved _contact_card height 825px -> index.css min-width:961px rule forces height:var(--ed-h) -> boxed-layout.css line 374 overflow:auto !important -> the content (871-941px) is taller than the card -> the card scrolls inside itself (the right-edge scrollbar in the user's screenshot), and the submit button is hidden. Fix: let the height grow (height auto, min-height the saved height, overflow visible) and add the move offset as bottom margin so the card does not overlap the footer.
